Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the WebSurfer had successfully retrieved the correct information from the Wikipedia page in Step 5. The Wikipedia page explicitly stated the director was "Brad Silberling" and the metadata confirmed the film title. Despite this, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the director was "Barry Sonnenfeld" (who was mentioned in the text as the original director before Sonnenfeld left) and proceeded to instruct the WebSurfer to verify "Barry Sonnenfeld" instead of the correct "Brad Silberling." This led to a cycle of repeated timeouts trying to access IMDb to confirm the wrong director, rather than accepting the verified information already present in the conversation.
